title: Secret read from the process environment (c)
description: The code reads a secret from the environment with getenv. The environment is visible in process listings, inherited by every child and captured in dumps, so a credential placed there leaks to anything that can look. This lexical rule flags the read; the reviewer checks what it protects.
remediation: Load secrets from a restricted file or a secret manager, for example a 0600 secret file or a secret manager, and keep them out of the environment.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the read without knowing whether the value is a secret.
